narrative_summary:
The reporting period for this summary is from 2024-12-27 to 2025-12-26 [[E:period.start], [E:period.end]]. A total of 1024 cases were received during this period [[E:case.total]]. Of these, 1023 cases were serious [[E:case.serious]], representing 99.9% of all cases [[E:case.serious_pct]]. One case was non-serious [[E:case.non_serious]].

Regarding patient demographics, 674 cases involved patients aged 65 years or older [[E:age.65plus]]. This represents 65.8% of all cases [[E:age.65plus_pct_all]] and 71.9% of cases with usable age information [[E:age.65plus_pct_known]]. The configured age bands include "<18", "18-44", "45-64", "65-74", and "75+" [[E:age.band_definitions]]. For sex, 503 cases were reported for females [[E:sex.female]], 493 for males [[E:sex.male]], and 28 cases had unknown sex [[E:sex.unknown]].

The top three reporting locations were EU with 342 cases (33.4%) [[E:geo.top1]], United Kingdom with 278 cases (27.1%) [[E:geo.top2]], and France with 185 cases (18.1%) [[E:geo.top3]]. The `occurcountry` field includes both country values and the aggregate value 'eu' [[E:geo.mixed_granularity]].

The most frequently reported reactions were Acute kidney injury, observed in 80 cases (7.8%) [[E:reaction.top1]]; Drug ineffective, in 54 cases (5.3%) [[E:reaction.top2]]; Hypotension, in 46 cases (4.5%) [[E:reaction.top3]]; Drug interaction, in 43 cases (4.2%) [[E:reaction.top4]]; and Dyspnoea, in 38 cases (3.7%) [[E:reaction.top5]].

Regarding case outcomes, 494 cases were reported as recovered/resolved [[E:outcome.case.recovered_resolved]]. There were 329 cases with an unknown outcome [[E:outcome.case.unknown]], and 68 cases had a fatal outcome [[E:outcome.case.fatal]].

A peak in case reporting was observed in 2025-07, with 109 cases [[E:trend.peak_month]]. The lowest number of cases for a full calendar month within the reporting interval was 64 cases in 2025-08 [[E:trend.lowest_full_month]]. It is noted that 2024-12 and 2025-12 are partial calendar months due to the reporting period running from 2024-12-27 through 2025-12-26 [[E:trend.boundary_note]].

serious_alerts:
A total of 1023 cases were identified as serious [[E:case.serious]]. Among these, 68 cases involved death [[E:seriousness.death]], 105 cases were life-threatening [[E:seriousness.life_threatening]], and 482 cases resulted in hospitalization [[E:seriousness.hospitalization]]. Additionally, 44 cases involved disability [[E:seriousness.disabling]], 7 cases involved congenital anomaly [[E:seriousness.congenital_anomaly]], and 905 cases were classified as other medically important conditions [[E:seriousness.other_medically_important]].

Regarding expedite criteria, 1023 cases fulfilled these criteria [[E:expedite.yes]], representing 99.9% of all cases [[E:expedite.pct]]. It is noted that the `fulfillexpeditecriteria` flag is treated as an expedite-criteria indicator and not as proof of a verified 15-day Alert submission [[E:expedite.limitations]]. Explicit expectedness/listedness fields and 15-day submission dates are not available in the supplied data [[E:expedite.limitations]].
trends: The reporting period includes partial calendar months for 2024-12 and 2025-12 [[E:trend.boundary_note]]. A total of 21 cases were reported in 2024-12 [[E:trend.monthly_cases]], and 83 cases were reported in 2025-12 [[E:trend.monthly_cases]]. The peak month for case reporting was 2025-07, with 109 cases [[E:trend.peak_month]]. The lowest number of cases for a complete calendar month was 64 in 2025-08 [[E:trend.lowest_full_month]]. Monthly case counts ranged from 64 [[E:trend.lowest_full_month]] to 109 [[E:trend.peak_month]] during the complete months of the reporting period.
